description: Deli Legal Data MCP service providing authoritative legal data retrieval, covering 160M+ court judgments and 3M+ laws and regulations. Supports case retrieval, statute retrieval and legal Q&A via natural language, with semantic search by case facts, disputes, statute names or provisions, plus detail and validity lookups.
